title: Potassium & the ECG

findings.where: Source: kit.jsx Gauge valueBad/pinFill logic; potassium.jsx Gauge colour props. Gauge in images 1–2, 8–10 and 16.
findings.title: Every abnormal potassium result receives critical-state colouring
findings.problem: The gauge assigns danger/coral styling to any value outside 3.5–5.0, including supplied cases such as 3.49 and 5.01. Those values establish an abnormal lab category, not a critical state. The HYPO/HYPER category labels are also permanently coral. This conflicts with the project's critical/incorrect-only meaning for coral.
findings.fix: Keep generic category labels neutral. Use caution styling for noncritical abnormalities, reserving coral for explicitly critical teaching scenarios; do not derive critical status solely from being outside the reference range.

assessment: No substantiated clinical blocker found. One minor colour-semantics rule violation remains.
